The affixes अञ् and खञ् come optionally after the word महाकुल।

Terms: अञ् and खञ्

The affixes घ and अण् and छ come after the name महेन्द्र in the sense of 'this its deity'.

Terms: घ , अण् and छ

The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'this its deity' after the words 1. महाराज and 2. प्रोष्ठपद।

Terms: ठञ्

The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'this is his object of veneration' after the word महाराज।

Terms: ठञ्

The word महत् (महा) retains its accent before the following - 1. व्रीहि 2. अपराह्ण 3. गृष्टि 4. इष्वास 5. जाबाल 6. भार 7. भारत 8. हैलिहिल 9. रौरव and 10. प्रवृद्धे।

Terms: कर्मधारय समास
